findings.message: The first `tool.call` handler awaits `next(e)`, which runs the tool, and then calls `refresh($)`. Its `.catch(($, e, next) => next(e))` calls `next(e)` again without checking `next.called`. If `refresh` throws after the tool has run, the tool call is dispatched a second time. The gate handler below guards this case with `!next.called`; this one does not. Fix by making the catch return the already-obtained result when `next.called`, or by wrapping only the `refresh` call in try/catch. No test drives `register.tsx` at all.
findings.scenario: The model runs Bash `echo x >> .specclaw/log && deploy.sh`. The tool runs, then `$.session.cwd()` or `$.fs.list` rejects inside `refresh`. The catch calls `next(e)` again and `deploy.sh` executes a second time.

findings.message: `readJson` returns `null` for the text `null`, but `parseChange` only checks `json === undefined`. `json.phase` then throws a TypeError. Other valid non-object JSON (`42`, `[]`, `"x"`) gets phase `proposal` instead of `?`. `refresh` has no catch at the session.start, turn.complete or command.run call sites, so one bad state.json breaks the status line, band and pane for every change. AC2 only tests unparsable text. Treat any non-object JSON as malformed (`?`) and add table rows for `null`, `42`, `[]` and `"s"`.
findings.scenario: `.specclaw/changes/001-x/state.json` contains `null`. `parseChange` throws `TypeError: null is not an object`, `refresh` rejects, and the status line and band never update.

findings.message: `normalise` and `relativeInside` handle only POSIX `/` paths. On Windows, `cwd` like `C:\proj` and `path` like `C:\proj\src\a.ts` never produce an inside-the-project relative path, so `relativeInside` returns undefined and the gate returns ALLOW. The guard is silently disabled while it appears active. A path that cannot be resolved should fail closed (deny or warn), or backslashes should be normalised first.
findings.scenario: Windows session, cwd `C:\proj`, no approved change, gate `block`. An Edit on `C:\proj\src\a.ts` is allowed with no toast.

findings.message: Everything under `.specclaw/` is always allowed, including `state.json`, which is what the gate reads for `approved`. The model can write `phases.proposal.status = "approved"` and then edit source files. The README's known-gaps list does not mention this. Document it, or deny edits to `state.json` unless a change is approved.
findings.scenario: No approved change exists. The model Edits `.specclaw/changes/001-x/state.json` to set the approved status, which is allowed, then Edits `src/a.ts`, which is now allowed.

findings.message: When `claude` is not on PATH (as in CI), `claude plugin validate` is skipped. The script still ends with `ALL PASS`, so a manifest or hooks error is not caught there. Print a not-run summary instead of ALL PASS, or install `claude` in CI. `oven-sh/setup-bun@v2` is also unpinned to a bun version.
findings.scenario: CI has no `claude` binary. A bad `plugin.json` passes the specclaw-mod step with ALL PASS.
